sources.note: Enable 'Use PT to pay fees' toggle for a flat 20% discount on both spot and futures trading fees. PT holdings do NOT qualify fee tiers (qualification is volume-only). Up to 40% discount is cited in some marketing materials but the standard verified deduction is 20%.

binance.description: Pay fees with BNB for 25% off spot, 10% off futures.

okx.description: OKB discount is woven into OKX VIP tiers, no additional token discount layer.

gate.description: Pay fees with GT: futures maker drops to 0%. Holding GT tiers give 10-50% off all fees.

mexc.description: MX deduction toggle: 20% off spot+futures. Holding 500+ MX grants 50% off automatically; the greater discount applies (they do not stack).

bitget.description: Pay fees with BGB for 20% off spot and futures (0.02%/0.06% -> 0.016%/0.048% at VIP0).

kucoin.description: Enable 'Use KCS to pay fees' (any KCS balance; ~6 KCS also unlocks the daily KCS bonus) for 20% off spot Class A/B/C and futures fees, e.g. VIP0 spot 0.10%/0.10% -> 0.08%/0.08%. At VIP8+ maker is already 0%, so the KCS discount effectively applies to the taker side only. KCS holdings of 1,000-150,000 KCS also qualify VIP1-12 via the holdings track (see fee tiers).

hyperliquid.description: Staking-linked discount (NOT a fee-payment toggle): stake 10/100/1k/10k/100k/500k HYPE to get 5/10/15/20/30/40% off all maker+taker fees, spot and perps. Stacks multiplicatively with the volume tier. Merely holding HYPE in the trading account gives no discount — tokenBalance should be the STAKED amount linked to the account. Holding HYPE does not qualify any fee tier (qualification is volume-only).

phemex.description: Enable 'Use PT to pay fees' toggle for 20% off spot and futures fees. PT holdings do NOT qualify fee tiers (Phemex tier qualification is 30-day volume only).
